editorNote: Two threads today. Agent reliability: Anthropic is cutting its internal evals off from the live internet, and a model’s false homicide tip reached Philadelphia police. Math: reports say OpenAI’s latest results are arriving faster than mathematicians can check them, and Epoch AI asks how close AI is to automating AI research. Otherwise a quiet day for releases.
